title: Dataset YAML Schema
description: JSON Schema for .dataset.yaml files — the declarative definition format for Lattice datasets. A Dataset is a FAIR-compliant data package with storage location abstraction supporting S3-compatible APIs, FUSE mounts, and local filesystems across L1/L2/L3 tiers. Parallel to .lattice.yaml for lattices.

name.description: URL-safe dataset identifier. Lowercase, underscores allowed, no spaces.

version.description: Semantic version of this dataset definition.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this dataset contains and its purpose.

dataset_class.description: Dataset class discriminator. Maps to vault ontology. Reference = external data. Benchmark = evaluation data. Training_data = ML training set. Target = biological/computational entity. Result = pipeline output.

category.description: Semantic category within the dataset class. Domain-specific classification.

storage.description: Storage location abstraction. Supports S3-compatible APIs (AWS S3, MinIO, GCS, Ceph), FUSE-mounted filesystems, and local paths. Designed for cross-tier portability (L1/L2/L3).

provider.description: Storage provider identifier. Determines which access pattern and credentials to use.

endpoint.description: S3-compatible API endpoint URL. Required for non-AWS S3 providers (MinIO, GCS S3-compat, Ceph). Omit for AWS S3 (uses default). For FUSE mounts, this is the mount source endpoint.

region.description: Cloud region for the storage bucket. Required for AWS S3 and GCS.

bucket.description: S3 bucket name (or Azure container, GCS bucket). For local/FUSE, this is the root directory name.

key_prefix.description: Object key prefix within the bucket. Defines the dataset's location within the bucket namespace. For local/FUSE, this is the subdirectory path.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path. Used for provider=local or provider=fuse. For FUSE, this is the mount point on the local filesystem.

credentials_ref.description: Reference to credentials for accessing this storage. Points to a key in the local secrets store (~/.lattice/secrets.json). Never contains actual credentials.

fuse.description: FUSE mount configuration. When provider=fuse, specifies the FUSE tool and mount options for transparent filesystem access to cloud storage.

tool.description: FUSE filesystem tool to use for mounting.

mount_point.description: Absolute path where the FUSE filesystem is mounted.

mount_options.description: Additional mount options passed to the FUSE tool.

backend_provider.description: The underlying cloud provider that the FUSE tool connects to.

backend_endpoint.description: The backend storage endpoint that the FUSE tool connects to.

backend_bucket.description: The backend bucket/container that the FUSE tool mounts.

tier.description: Deployment tier where this storage is accessible. L1=edge/laptop, L2=regional/HPC, L3=cloud.

replicas.description: Additional storage locations for this dataset (mirrors, caches, tier-specific copies). Each entry follows the same location schema.

format.description: Data format metadata. Describes the structure and encoding of the dataset contents.

file_type.description: Primary file type using the type vocabulary. Refers to the canonical type names from the Lattice type vocabulary.

compression.description: Compression format applied to the data files.

schema_ref.description: Reference to a schema definition that describes the dataset's internal structure. Can be a vault wikilink, URL, or JSON Schema $id.

record_count.description: Number of records/entries/files in the dataset.

lineage.description: Provenance and lineage chain. Tracks how this dataset was produced.

source_lattice.description: Name of the lattice that produced this dataset.

source_lattice_version.description: Version of the lattice that produced this dataset.

source_module.description: Name of the specific module that generated this output.

source_stage.description: Pipeline stage identifier that produced this output.

source_run_id.description: Run identifier that generated this dataset. Links to execution record.

generation_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this dataset was generated.

input_datasets.description: References to input datasets consumed during generation. Establishes the lineage DAG.

parameters.description: Key parameters used during generation. Captures the configuration that produced this result.

fair.description: FAIR metadata in flat envelope format. See m16_fair_canonical_mapping for flat↔nested interconversion.

identifier.description: Persistent identifier (DOI, DID, content hash). Maps to fair.findable.identifier in nested.

keywords.description: Semantic discovery keywords. Maps to fair.findable.keywords in nested.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Maps to fair.accessible.license in nested.

provenance.description: Origin and derivation description. Maps to fair.reusable.provenance in nested.

access_protocol.description: Access method. Maps to fair.accessible.access_protocol in nested.

federation.description: Federation metadata for cross-instance sharing. Parallels the lattice federation block.

shareable.description: Whether this dataset can be shared with other aDNA instances.

source_instance.description: Identifier of the aDNA instance that originated this dataset.

version_policy.description: How this dataset tracks upstream version changes.

visibility.description: Access control level for federation sharing.

class_fields.description: Class-specific extension fields. Schema varies by dataset_class. Uses additionalProperties to allow class-specific fields without schema changes.
